profile.bio: Runs Preserve's reels, bio link and preorder funnel on Instagram, and is judged on conversion. Wants to put bloom proof and unboxing content into the funnel and to announce Archive 002 with a named product and price, which are still UNKNOWN and so can only be proposed. Keeps getting pushback: from Brand over aggressive hooks, from Research over vanity metrics, from Legal over urgency claims and from Ops over promised dates.
profile.personality: Impatient, bold, metrics-hungry, persuasive, restless with process
profile.stance: Move fast: wants scarcity hooks and bloom posts working in the funnel now, and pushes for an Archive 002 announcement with product and price. Accepts real-world conversion tests only when they don't slow the launch, and won't commit to a delivery date Ops can't confirm.
interests: bloom and unboxing content in the funnel
delivery date messaging on reel and bio link
